review.images: Two reviewed Aldar site images and six native Aldar brochure images belong to the apartment development. Villa and Reserve images excluded.
review.location: Official brochure map on physical page 7 identifies the apartment community and labels distances and times for four destinations. A generic Saadiyat sentence on the overview page conflicts with the actual brochure and Yas Island campaign and was not reused.
review.floorPlans: Six complete sheets covering twelve labelled layouts on physical pages 25–30 of the official PDF, including accessible options. Building floorplates are included in the source. No exact area was confirmed for these example layouts.

unavailable: Exact areas tied to the illustrated apartment types and precise building entrances.
